routes.label: through the Ministry of the Interior's services

note: Tunisia's national identity card is issued under the Ministry of the Interior. The biometric card approved in December 2023 was to cost 25 to 40 dinars, the chair of the parliamentary rights and liberties committee said, once its regulations were finalised (Managers, 16 March 2024); whether it has replaced the current card, and the current card's stamp duty, term, age and time, weren't found.

sources.title: Managers (Tunisia), Combien les Tunisiens vont-ils payer pour le passeport et la CIN biométriques? (16 March 2024)
sources.said: En ce qui concerne la Carte d’Identité Nationale (CIN), son prix varie de 25 à 40 dinars. ... Les projets de la carte d’identité et du passeport biométriques ont été approuvés depuis le 1er décembre, en attendant la finalisation des textes réglementaires.
